note: SIMPLE RANKING LOSS + PAE + L2-SP at the pair_transition-block-3 trainable set, 25 epochs. DROPS from xmz9ge: --rank-pairs all, --rank-within-weight 8, --rank-tau 0.0270 -- the ranking term is plain cross-seed softplus at DEFAULT_TAU 0.0305 again. ADDS --alpha-pae 1, where every arm since h7msge ran alpha_pae 0 and made ordering the only term. TRAINABLE SET UNCHANGED at 17 tensors / 830,976 parameters: the 12 orientation+distance tensors plus pairformer_stack.blocks.3.pair_transition. ALL THREE WEIGHTS MEASURED AT THESE WEIGHTS from probe jn2pg7, not guessed. alpha_pae 1 is the reference every PAE arm uses. alpha_rank 5.347 is GRADIENT PARITY AT INIT: the probe reports |g_PAE| 2.5742e-01 against |g_rank| 4.8142e-02 in one accumulation window at identical weights and prints the parity ratio itself, so the two terms contribute equal gradient magnitude at step 0 -- the same method that set arm B's 2.058. lambda 5e-04 is ~10x the ranking-only value because L2-SP strength is 2*lambda*||dW||/|g_task| and |g_task| is now COMBINED: |g_PAE + 5.347 g_rank| = 0.4225 against 0.0481 for ranking alone, so l2sp_lambda.py transfers 24u34d's 2.5e-4 as 2.5e-4 * (0.4225/0.0402) / sqrt(827904/40960) = 5.84e-4, used as 5e-04. THE TWO OBJECTIVES AGREE: cos(PAE, rank) = +0.3466, so the ranking term reinforces the PAE direction rather than fighting it. That is the reason to expect anything here -- the ranking loss ALONE produces per-pose gradients as good as mutually independent (alignment 0.107 against a 1/sqrt(N) baseline of 0.100, ~90% of its magnitude destroyed by cancellation every step) while PAE's are nearly parallel, so PAE supplies a coherent direction the ranking term can sharpen. PARITY HOLDS AT INITIALISATION ONLY: in 4y3ve6 the ranking gradient decayed ~22x over 11 epochs as pairs became ordered, so the ranking term fades relative to PAE as training proceeds -- an accidental annealing schedule that points the right way, but alpha_rank is a STARTING ratio. THE LAMBDA TRANSFER COMPARES UNLIKE QUANTITIES, stated rather than hidden: the old side is ranking-only at alpha_pae 0, the new side combined; the invariant preserved is still anchor strength relative to the task gradient, but 5e-04 is a principled starting point and not a tuned value. CONTROLS: xmz9ge (same trainable set, within-seed weighting, NO PAE -- stopped at epoch 9 having put 89% of its total training-loss fall into epoch 1->2 and then plateaued at 0.0365 while selection swung +-0.07 DockQ per epoch) and hronsr (44,032 parameters, within-seed weighting, no PAE, paired +0.0116 over epochs 8-15). CRITERION: selected DockQ and fraction above 0.23 over the 18 val10 interfaces against shipped DockQ 0.2909 / frac 0.5556 / oracle 0.5968, from this run's own shards. Spearman is reported but is NOT the criterion. TEN-EPOCH MINIMUM before any trend claim; reported at 15 as well so it stays comparable to the three 15-epoch arms. FALSIFIER: the same 0.037 plateau at epoch 2 with selection still swinging, which would say PAE's coherent direction does not rescue a ranking signal that cancels itself.
